stops.title: British Museum: Egypt galleries, the Great Court, then the King's Library

stops.approach: Go in by the main entrance and start in Room 4, the Egyptian sculpture gallery, on the west side of the Great Court.
stops.what: From the stone statues of the Egypt gallery you step out into the huge white Great Court under its glass roof, cross it, and walk into the long King's Library: shelves of books, warm wood and gold, and cases of collected objects.
